About this book

Little Animals, Lovely Days follows three woodland friends through the everyday moments that make a lovely day: a lakeside picnic, an afternoon of baking, a morning in the garden. The lines are bolder and simpler than our other two books, which makes this one a relaxed evening project for experienced colorists and a friendly starting point for anyone newer to coloring.

Forty original scenes, each a full-page, single-sided design with a blank sheet behind it, in the same 8.5-inch square format as the rest of the collection.

Because it's printed by Amazon on demand, we can't promise the paper is marker-proof. Heavy alcohol-based markers may still show through, so we recommend slipping a spare sheet of paper behind whichever page you're working on, and testing a new pen in a corner first.

Questions about this book

What age is this good for?

It's designed for adults and teens, with bolder and simpler lines than our other two books. Confident younger colorists tend to enjoy it too, though we haven't formally age-graded it.

Is it easier than your other books?

The lines are bolder and the shapes larger, so yes — it's a good pick if you want a quicker, more relaxed coloring session.

Is it the same size as the other two books?

Yes — all three Craven & Quill books are the same 8.5 × 8.5 inch square format, so they sit neatly together on a shelf.
